hook: HC gives Telangana *8 weeks* to bring a lift safety Bill
hook_b: HC gives Telangana *8 weeks* to bring a lift safety Bill
tldr: A bench of Acting CJ Sam Koshy and Justice Chalapathi Rao directed the Chief Secretary to speed up the long-delayed Elevator Safety Bill for multi-storey buildings.

beats.what: In a suo motu PIL, the High Court on Tuesday told the Chief Secretary to expedite the elevator safety law and place the draft Bill before Cabinet within eight weeks.
beats.why: The court registered the case from letters flagging no legal framework for lift safety; accidents include the death of a police battalion commandant last year, allegedly due to poor maintenance.
beats.care: The proposed law would regulate safety and maintenance of elevators in multi-storey buildings, where many Hyderabad residents live and work.
